title: Create: Assembly Acquired
description: A Compatibility Mod for Create to Disassembly Required.
body:
Create: Assembly Acquired. I seek to bridge the gap between Create and Disassembly Required. The function of this mod is to allow for the creation and automation of drone parts and drone workers as well as some added functionality for renewing resources into materials. 

Currently The mod really only supports a handful of Create functionalities. Crushing via crushing wheels of some of the stones. Mechanical compacting of bloodstone into little increments of oil. More will be added.
